Telangana CM Claims YSR's Last Wish Was Rahul Gandhi Becoming PM

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy stated that the final wish of former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy (YSR) was for Rahul Gandhi to become Prime Minister. Reddy called for a united effort to achieve this goal. He made these remarks in the context of fulfilling YSR's wish.
